title: Atmospheric Fauna: Unofficial Fabric Port
description: An unofficial Fabric 1.20.1 port of Atmospheric Fauna
body:
Atmospheric Fauna: Unofficial Fabric Port

This project is an unofficial Fabric 1.20.1 port of Atmospheric Fauna, published with permission from the original author.

Original Mod Page

About Atmospheric Fauna

Atmospheric Fauna adds crows to Minecraft, introducing new ambient wildlife that naturally fits into the vanilla world. These birds help make the environment feel more alive while maintaining Minecraft's original atmosphere.

About This Port

This project brings Atmospheric Fauna to Fabric 1.20.1 while preserving the original gameplay experience as closely as possible.

In addition to Fabric, this port can also be used on Forge 1.20.1 through the Connector mod.

Requirements

Fabric:

  • Fabric API
  • Cloth Config API

Forge:

  • Connector
  • Forgified Fabric API
  • Cloth Config API

Credits & Copyright

Atmospheric Fauna, including all original code, assets, textures, models, sounds, and concepts, is the property of the original author. This project is an unofficial port released with the author's permission and is not an official release or continuation of the original project.
